name: Scout v4
title: Scout v4
note: Scout v4 shape design (8 Nov, Spark: new props, no Bee35, everything printed in PCTG, still seats in the landing funnel for the battery swapper): Gemfan 5125 props on a printed frame, the v3 base and battery unchanged, a half cage on the new discs. -160..162 x -160..160 x -48..123 mm, ~706 g (E). tools/scout_v4_shape.py

parts.name: frame v4 room (printed PCTG deck, arms and motor pods: the design envelope)
parts.note: replaces the Bee35 plate: deck x -60..60, |y| 40, z 18.5..24.5 (the plate's underside kept, the units bolt up into it), arms 18 wide to O30 pods at (+-74.3, +-74.3), a lug down each side to z -14 for the cage's side triangles, a socket at the tail end; mass at 45 % of the envelope (E, the engine sizes it); printed in PCTG

parts.name: base v4 room (yokes over the receiver, nose bay, flow pod, tail tray, nose stub)
parts.note: the receiver-only seat (9 Nov, Spark: "seat the scout on the receiver alone"; the funnel's end walls move in for the Scout): no runners or keel. Yokes over the receiver (its top z 9.6 to the deck), the nose bay for the FC, the flow sensor's pod, the tail tray for the Radxa, UBEC and XR2, the stub out to NB; every bottom on the walls-in rule + 2 (zmin_walls_in); mass at 30 % of the envelope (E); printed in PCTG

parts.name: front camera and probe head (Arducam 1080P Low Light colour USB, IMX291 100 deg, on an SG90 tilt servo, white LEDs, VL53L0X)
parts.note: parked on the throat it is the front camera, lens (38, 0, 108), 15 deg up, 1920 x 1080 colour at 30 fps, ~92 x 61 deg; rolled out on the two blades it is the ceiling probe. Camera board and lens 14 E, SG90 9, VL53L0X 0.7, LEDs 0.3, cradle and clip 2.5, TPU rim guard 1.5

parts.name: ceiling probe turret (two-blade 0.3 m mast, spool, gears, clock-spring drum, N20 in the deck, throat)
parts.note: two 10 mm steel blades 0.4 m 7.6, flat cable 2 x 300 mm 2, spool with its 40 T gear 5, clock-spring drum 2, housing and throat 6 (PCTG), N20 300 rpm with encoder 10.5, 15 T pinion 0.3, DRV8833 1, TPU lip 1, wires 1 (E)

parts.name: FC MicoAir743 AIO (in the nose bay)
parts.note: 36 x 36 at x 56..92 under the deck (its place at the deck's centre is the turret's); set its IMU offset in PX4 (EKF2_IMU_POS_X ~ +0.074 m)

parts.name: half cage v4, rods (3 mm carbon: the ring, the flat roof, end Vs and side fans)
parts.note: 34 rods, 3.81 m, every one 12 from the swept discs and none over or under a disc: ring at z 61 with flats at 155 (310 across), a flat roof (spine on y 0, hoop on x 0, nose / tail triangles), a V at each end and a fan at each side down to the bottom nodes, which hang on rod triangles to the deck's side lugs and tail (NB on the camera's mount)

parts.name: half cage v4, nodes (spheres for now: the node design comes once the geometry is settled)
parts.note: 16 cage nodes; the larger spheres are sockets printed into the frame and the base (NB on the nose stub, two on each side lug, the deck's tail end, the tail tray's end)
